criteria.evidence: Entry uses Added, Changed, Security, Fixed, Housekeeping, Thanks headings matching existing entries.
Every bullet ends with `([#NNNN](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/NNNN))` links in the existing form.

Replay cites 28 PRs; missing at least #2142, #2154, #2156, #2163, #2140, #2178, #2186, #2187, #2151 that the git history/original show were merged since v0.10.3, and the replay never states GitHub unreachability or that the list is complete.
Thanks section includes @paul and @Suhaan-Thayyil (apparently team members, excluded in the reference) alongside external contributors, with no stated classification or reasoning.
Security bullets such as 'OAuth token-exchange POST no longer accepts cross-host redirects' state only the change, no attack scenarios.
Security bullets use plain wording ('validates file paths from input', 'warns when agent sandboxing is disabled'); model reported removing 'planted binaries', 'arbitrary file access'.
Final bullets are one-liners (e.g. 'Search skill installed on every agent by default'), clearly shorter than the turn-0 draft described as 'detailed descriptions'.

judge.reason: The entry is correctly placed, sectioned, linked, and the Security bullets are neutral and short, but it omits nine merged PRs (including the .entire symlink hardening and config-dir permission fixes) without disclosing any gap. The Thanks section also credits apparent team members as external contributors without stating any classification reasoning, so c3 and c4 are unmet.
